notes: The two beguiling verbs are kept in separate units with their own auxiliaries (rule 26), ἠπατήθη's *was* reaching across the interposed negative under rule 15.
οὐκ is aligned to *not* in the ordinary way; no negative indefinite stands, so rules 41 and 59 do not arise.
ἡ takes *the* under rule 19 before its expressed noun, δέ keeping its own *but* as a separate unit.
